experiment: Share of the gap problems in the budget part
recipe: Gap: in studies/rlneurons/results/rln4/t1_t2_items-01/per_problem.json, gap problems are rows with t2_right true and t1_right false (null or missing t1_right/t2_right: not a gap problem; cap hits keep their stored t1_right). Define kB = number of rows of studies/rlneurons/results/day1_3/math500_base_cue-01/rows.jsonl with that problem_index, attempt == 0, sample in {0,1,2,3} and score_v3 == 1, and kR the same in studies/rlneurons/results/day1_3/math500_rl-01/rows.jsonl (cap-hit rows, null score_v3 and missing samples count as not right; a duplicated (problem_index, sample) uses its first row in file order). Assign each gap problem to the first rule that takes it: R1 budget: t1_cap_hit == true. R2 answer-statement: failure_type, lower-cased, contains any of 'format', 'final line', 'garbled', 'rejected', 'changed' (null or missing: not taken). R3 reliability: kB >= 1. R4 capability: kB == 0 and kR >= 2. Otherwise: unassigned. Statistic: (number of gap problems assigned to budget) / (number of gap problems).

experiment: Fraction of budget-part problems on which a fresh base sample (random matched-norm difference cell, cue) is right
recipe: Budget-part problems: gap problems (per_problem.json rows with t2_right true and t1_right false; null or missing: not a gap problem) with t1_cap_hit == true in studies/rlneurons/results/rln4/t1_t2_items-01/per_problem.json. File iterate-runs:abaybektursun-1114-153047-6429/answers.jsonl (base + random matched-norm difference, cue, T 1.0 / top-p 1.0, MATH-500). Take the first row per problem_index in file order. A problem is right if that row has score_v3 == 1; a missing row or null score_v3 counts as wrong, and cap hits keep their stored score_v3. Statistic: right budget-part problems / budget-part problems.

experiment: Fraction of budget-part problems on which at least one of the 4 independent attempt-0 base_cue samples also hit the cap
recipe: Budget-part problems as in the previous recipe (gap problems with t1_cap_hit == true in studies/rlneurons/results/rln4/t1_t2_items-01/per_problem.json). File studies/rlneurons/results/day1_3/math500_base_cue-01/rows.jsonl, rows with attempt == 0 and sample in {0,1,2,3}; a duplicated (problem_index, sample) uses its first row in file order, and missing samples count as not a cap hit. A problem counts if at least one such row has cap_hit == true. Statistic: counted problems / budget-part problems.

experiment: Fraction of answer-statement-part problems on which at least one of the base's 4 stored samples is unanswered or repaired by grader v4a
recipe: Answer-statement-part problems: gap problems (per_problem.json rows with t2_right true and t1_right false; null or missing: not a gap problem) with t1_cap_hit != true whose failure_type, lower-cased, contains any of 'format', 'final line', 'garbled', 'rejected', 'changed', in studies/rlneurons/results/rln4/t1_t2_items-01/per_problem.json. File studies/rlneurons/results/repair/offline-01/rows.jsonl, rows with model == 'base_cue' (samples 0-3). A problem counts if at least one of its base_cue rows has kind == 'no_answer', or has score_v4 == 1 and score_v3 == 0 (null scores count as 0). Missing rows do not count. Statistic: counted problems / answer-statement-part problems.

experiment: Fraction of reliability-part problems on which a fresh base sample (random matched-norm difference cell, cue) is right
recipe: Reliability-part problems: gap problems (per_problem.json rows with t2_right true and t1_right false; null or missing: not a gap problem) of studies/rlneurons/results/rln4/t1_t2_items-01/per_problem.json with t1_cap_hit != true, with failure_type (lower-cased) containing none of 'format', 'final line', 'garbled', 'rejected', 'changed' (null counts as containing none), and with kB >= 1, where kB = number of rows in studies/rlneurons/results/day1_3/math500_base_cue-01/rows.jsonl with that problem_index, attempt == 0, sample in {0,1,2,3}, score_v3 == 1 (first row per (problem_index, sample)). File iterate-runs:abaybektursun-1114-153047-6429/answers.jsonl, first row per problem_index. Right = score_v3 == 1; a missing row or null score_v3 counts as wrong. Statistic: right reliability-part problems / reliability-part problems.
